quests.instruction: Listen to the audio and select the matching emotion.
quests.hint: Listen for very enthusiastic language and phrases that celebrate great personal news.
quests.explanation: The phrase 'best day of my life' combined with exclamation marks shows the speaker is overwhelmed with happiness.
quests.textToSpeak: I just got accepted into my dream university! This is the best day of my life!

quests.instruction: Listen to the audio and select the matching emotion.
quests.hint: Notice the phrase 'can't stop crying' and the reason the speaker gives.
quests.explanation: 'Can't stop crying' paired with the loss of a pet are unmistakable signals of deep sadness.
quests.textToSpeak: I can't stop crying. My dog passed away this morning.

quests.instruction: Listen to the audio and select the matching emotion.
quests.hint: Pay attention to the repeated complaint and the frustrated question at the end.
quests.explanation: Repeating a complaint and using 'Why won't you' expresses strong frustration and anger.
quests.textToSpeak: I told you three times already! Why won't you just listen to me?

quests.instruction: Listen to the audio and select the matching emotion.
quests.hint: Look for words that show the speaker did not expect this news at all.
quests.explanation: The disbelief in 'You said nothing!' about an unexpected event clearly expresses surprise.
quests.textToSpeak: You got married? But I just saw you last week and you said nothing!

quests.instruction: Listen to the audio and select the matching emotion.
quests.hint: Think about what repeatedly checking the time before an important event tells you.
quests.explanation: Checking your phone repeatedly before something important is a classic sign of anxiety and nervousness.
quests.textToSpeak: I keep checking my phone. The interview starts in twenty minutes.

quests.instruction: Listen to the audio and select the matching emotion.
quests.hint: Notice how early the speaker started preparing and how they talk about the trip.
quests.explanation: Packing a whole day early out of anticipation strongly suggests excitement about upcoming travel.
quests.textToSpeak: We're going to Paris! I've been packing my bag since last night!

quests.instruction: Listen to the audio and select the matching emotion.
quests.hint: Think about the emotional feeling the speaker connects to a simple, comforting experience.
quests.explanation: Describing something as 'exactly what I needed' and feeling 'warm inside' signals deep happiness and comfort.
quests.textToSpeak: Grandma's home-cooked meal was exactly what I needed. I feel so warm inside.

quests.instruction: Listen to the audio and select the matching emotion.
quests.hint: Focus on 'felt completely alone' and the image of watching someone leave without a word.
quests.explanation: Watching someone leave without a goodbye and feeling alone are powerful expressions of sadness.
quests.textToSpeak: He didn't even say goodbye. I watched the car drive away and felt completely alone.

quests.instruction: Listen to the audio and select the matching emotion.
quests.hint: Think about how someone feels when the same problem keeps happening to them.
quests.explanation: A repeated problem happening 'the second time' without any notice naturally creates anger.
quests.textToSpeak: This is the second time this month they changed my schedule without telling me!

quests.instruction: Listen to the audio and select the matching emotion.
quests.hint: Notice 'Wait' and the speaker's disbelief about seeing this person.
quests.explanation: 'Wait — is that really you?' expresses complete disbelief at an unexpected encounter.
quests.textToSpeak: Wait — is that really you? I haven't seen you in fifteen years!

quests.instruction: Listen to the audio and select the matching emotion.
quests.hint: 'Heart is racing' is a physical sign of emotion. Think about what causes that before a big event.
quests.explanation: A racing heart before a public performance is a classic physical symptom of nervousness.
quests.textToSpeak: My heart is racing. I have to speak in front of the whole school tomorrow.

quests.instruction: Listen to the audio and select the matching emotion.
quests.hint: Notice the countdown and the enthusiasm about the upcoming event.
quests.explanation: Counting down to a personal celebration and eagerly inviting everyone shows clear excitement.
quests.textToSpeak: Only three more days until my birthday party! I've invited absolutely everyone!

quests.instruction: Listen to the audio and select the matching emotion.
quests.hint: Think about the emotion typically associated with looking at joyful event photos.
quests.explanation: Describing everyone smiling at a wedding celebration reflects the speaker's happiness at the memory.
quests.textToSpeak: Look at these photos from the wedding. Everyone was smiling all day long.

quests.instruction: Listen to the audio and select the matching emotion.
quests.hint: Focus on 'gave up trying' and the feeling of hope that was never fulfilled.
quests.explanation: Giving up after waiting for improvement reflects a deep sense of sadness and loss of hope.
quests.textToSpeak: I thought things would get better, but they never did. I gave up trying.

quests.instruction: Listen to the audio and select the matching emotion.
quests.hint: The phrase 'I wonder' is a key signal. Think about what mystery is being described.
quests.explanation: 'I wonder' combined with an unexplained, nameless package clearly signals curiosity.
quests.textToSpeak: I wonder who left this package on my doorstep. There's no name on it.

quests.instruction: Listen to the audio and select the matching emotion.
quests.hint: Think about how someone feels after two hours of nothing happening.
quests.explanation: Waiting two hours with nothing happening and saying 'I can't take it' is a textbook expression of boredom.
quests.textToSpeak: We've been sitting here for two hours and nothing has happened. I can't take it anymore.

quests.instruction: Listen to the audio and select the matching emotion.
quests.hint: Notice the word 'disrespectful' and the accusatory tone of the complaint.
quests.explanation: Calling something 'disrespectful' in an accusatory tone is a direct expression of anger.
quests.textToSpeak: You borrowed my car and didn't even fill up the gas? That's so disrespectful!

quests.instruction: Listen to the audio and select the matching emotion.
quests.hint: Think about how it feels to complete something you have worked on for a very long time.
quests.explanation: Finishing a five-year personal project and saying 'It's done!' reflects strong happiness and accomplishment.
quests.textToSpeak: I finally finished my novel! Five years of work and it's done!

quests.instruction: Listen to the audio and select the matching emotion.
quests.hint: Shaking hands despite lots of preparation is a clear physical sign of a particular emotion.
quests.explanation: Shaking hands even after repeated rehearsal is a physical symptom of nervousness.
quests.textToSpeak: I've rehearsed my speech twenty times, but my hands are still shaking.

quests.instruction: Listen to the audio and select the matching emotion.
quests.hint: Think about how a person feels when they wait alone for people who never arrive.
quests.explanation: Waiting alone at your own birthday party with no guests arriving is a deeply sad image.
quests.textToSpeak: Nobody came to her birthday party. She sat alone and waited for hours.

quests.instruction: Listen to the audio and select the matching emotion.
quests.hint: 'Had no idea' tells you the speaker did not expect what happened at all.
quests.explanation: Not knowing about a surprise party and being shocked when revealed clearly expresses surprise.
quests.textToSpeak: I opened the door and everyone shouted 'Surprise!' I had no idea it was a party!

quests.instruction: Listen to the audio and select the matching emotion.
quests.hint: Being unable to sit still for a positive, long-awaited event signals a particular emotion.
quests.explanation: Inability to sit still from anticipation of a first-ever event is a classic sign of excitement.
quests.textToSpeak: I can't sit still. My favorite band is playing in this city for the very first time!

quests.instruction: Listen to the audio and select the matching emotion.
quests.hint: 'Happy tears' tells you the emotion directly, even though tears are involved.
quests.explanation: Crying 'happy tears' at a child's milestone clearly communicates joy and happiness.
quests.textToSpeak: My son took his first steps today. I cried happy tears.

quests.instruction: Listen to the audio and select the matching emotion.
quests.hint: A third repeated mistake and an immediate decision to complain signal a specific emotion.
quests.explanation: Experiencing the same mistake three times and deciding to complain immediately shows strong anger.
quests.textToSpeak: This is the third time the delivery has been wrong! I'm calling to complain right now!

quests.instruction: Listen to the audio and select the matching emotion.
quests.hint: Trying to figure out an unexplained situation in the middle of the night signals what feeling?
quests.explanation: Noticing something unusual and actively trying to work out what it means expresses curiosity.
quests.textToSpeak: The light under the door was on at midnight. I couldn't figure out who was inside.

quests.instruction: Listen to the audio and select the matching emotion.
quests.hint: Rereading the same thing repeatedly just before an important test suggests what emotion?
quests.explanation: Re-reading the same material before an exam signals nervousness and difficulty concentrating.
quests.textToSpeak: I keep reading the same paragraph over and over. The exam is tomorrow.

quests.instruction: Listen to the audio and select the matching emotion.
quests.hint: 'Breaks my heart' is a powerful emotional phrase. What does it tell you about the speaker?
quests.explanation: 'Breaks my heart' is an idiomatic phrase that directly communicates deep sadness.
quests.textToSpeak: She doesn't remember my name anymore. It breaks my heart to visit her.

quests.instruction: Listen to the audio and select the matching emotion.
quests.hint: 'There must be an error' suggests the speaker cannot believe what they found.
quests.explanation: Finding an unexpected, unexplained amount and assuming an error clearly expresses surprise and disbelief.
quests.textToSpeak: I checked my account and had ten times more money than expected. There must be an error!

quests.instruction: Listen to the audio and select the matching emotion.
quests.hint: A weight being 'lifted' after hearing good medical news signals which emotion?
quests.explanation: Feeling a 'weight lifted' after receiving good news is an idiomatic expression for relief and happiness.
quests.textToSpeak: The doctor said everything is fine. I feel like a huge weight has been lifted.

quests.instruction: Listen to the audio and select the matching emotion.
quests.hint: 'Stuck on repeat' describes daily routine with no change. What emotion does that suggest?
quests.explanation: Describing everyday life as 'stuck on repeat' with no variety reflects boredom.
quests.textToSpeak: Same report, same desk, same lunch every day. I feel like I'm stuck on repeat.
